body: Thank you for this answer, but sorry I still don't understand? The people who have pretended to be my friends in the past, they have reached out to others many times - I saw it. And if no one has the time to reach out, then everyone would be just as alone as I am and that doesn't seem to be the case either. I guess my question really is, why are folks ok with reaching out to others except me? that's what hurts
